description: Lisbon Public Transport Network Graph is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Joao Tiago Aparicio, Rui Henriques (National Laboratory for Civil Engineering). Dictionary of NetworkX Directed Graphs (nx.DiGraph), modeling different public transportation network graphs. There are 9 different graphs in the dictionary mapping to the main transport operators in the Lisbon metropolitan area:carriscpfertagusmetrorodlisboasoflusasulfertagustranstejotst. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
